dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: and plug up the arteries and other parts that were destroyed.

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: Just shut up and do it already.

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: Since I'm not exactly healing you, your pain will remain.

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: Please don't complain to me later.

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: Ow!

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: O-Ow! Be more gentle! Be more gentle, damn it, Giorno!

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: I told you, I can't.

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: You're a gangster, for crying out loud. Please quit fussing.

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: There are about more wounds,

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: so you'll have to remove some of your clothes for me to plug the rest.

dialogue.name: Nara
dialogue.speech: Bucciarati! I'm picking up two signals...

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: It doesn't look like there's anyone else.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: Proceed, but carefully.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: I'm assuming it's Mista and Giorno.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: I'm sure they're bored out of their minds waiting for us since nothing's happening.

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: Ack! Giorno!

dialogue.name: Nara
dialogue.speech: There they are! Hey, Mista! Gio—

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: Be gentler! Gentler, damn it!

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: Don't take off my clothes! I'll feel it more!

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: Well, Narancia? Did you find those two?

dialogue.name: Nara
dialogue.speech: Huh? W-Well, u-um...

dialogue.name: Nara
dialogue.speech: No! Huh?! Suddenly there's something in my eye?

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: Giorno, no! Don't! N-No more! I-I can't!

dialogue.name: Nara
dialogue.speech: I can't see! I can't see them clearly!

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: Be gentler, damn it!

dialogue.name: Risotto_s_wherea,Sign
dialogue.speech: Risotto's whereabouts are unknown.Currently searching airports, train stations,and the area around Naples.

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: Curse you, Risotto...

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: You must be heading to Venice.

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: If Bucciarati and his crew put an end to you, that's fine.

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: Regardless, I'm not worried.
